name: Draft short romantic messages for partners
description: Users asked the AI to generate short, concise romantic messages, such as good morning, good night, or birthday wishes, often tailored with specific tones, emojis, or cultural references like Qixi Festival. The requests focused on crafting brief, sweet expressions of love and affection rather than writing long-form love letters.
